falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern requires a higher low structure; breaking below the August 2024 panic low destroys the fractal similarity and confirms this is a different regime (continuation lower, not bottoming)

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts and stays positive for 5 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred during deep inversion; curve uninversion signals recession realization and forced de-risking, contradicting the 'blowoff score 41' soft-landing/technical-bottom thesis
